CODE
Art. 2.3.60. 
Invalidity of rights in case of dissolution for a cause other than death or divorce 
Without prejudice to Article 4.237, ¤ 4, dissolution of the matrimonial property regime by judicial separation as to property or by the contractual adoption of another matrimonial property regime entails the invalidity of any advantages which would result for a spouse from the method of composition, operation, liquidation or division of the joint patrimony and which are granted as rights of survivorship.
